G0.title: Funding eligibility & company structure documented
G0.pass: Company structure decided; sbir_eligible_now stated true/false; if excluded, a replacement non-dilutive/revenue funding spine named. Do NOT design the cap table around a grant.

G1.title: Desktop causal chain real on hardware
G1.pass: Computed from >=100 individual run records: readback >=99/100, tamper detection 100% of injected, canaries 100%, 0 silent gaps, Windows 11, screen-recording checksum present.

G2.title: Assessor signal on desktop outcome (Mode A/B) — make/break
G2.pass: Blind test, >=3 assessors reviewing, >=1 prefers desktop-outcome Mode B in writing with a reason, willingness-to-pay recorded.

G3.title: Market proof (paid/budgeted pilot + external repro + qualified workflows)
G3.pass: At least ONE paid or contractually budgeted pilot (budget owner, price, start date, workflow, decision date), AND >=1 external reproduction, AND >=3 qualified workflows. LOIs are a supporting metric, NOT the gate.

G4.title: Bus factor (recovery + reproducible build + key custodian)
G4.pass: Documented recovery/succession; reproducible build by ONE external person; second key custodian or secure recovery; >=1 external reviewer; active co-founder pipeline. 'Co-founder onboarded or 2 maintainers' is a 12-MONTH target, not a day-90 pass/fail.
